mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO batch_student_eligibility (batch_id, student_id, eligibility_status) SELECT #{batchId}, s.id, 'ELIGIBLE' FROM student s JOIN major m ON m.id = s.major_id WHERE m.enabled = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM selection_batch batch WHERE batch.id = #{batchId} AND batch.batch_status = 'DRAFT' )

INSERT IGNORE INTO batch_building_scope (batch_id, building_id) SELECT #{batchId}, building.id FROM dormitory_building building WHERE building.enabled = 1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM selection_batch batch WHERE batch.id = #{batchId} AND batch.batch_status = 'DRAFT' )
